description: A visual placeholder container shown when a section has no content. Composed of an icon, title, and description. Purely informational — not interactive.

keyboard.action: Empty state is a static display element — it is not interactive

focus.notes: Not focusable. If an action button is placed inside, it receives its own focus management.

announcements: Title is announced as a heading (h3)
Description text is announced as paragraph content
Icon is decorative and should have aria-hidden="true"

contrast.text: Title uses foreground, description uses muted-foreground — both meet WCAG AA

consumerResponsibilities: Use descriptive title text that explains why the section is empty
Add an action button (e.g., "Create new") when appropriate
Ensure icons inside EmptyStateIcon have aria-hidden="true"
